dedupe_keys.name: pcfm optical link performance calculator closed form gn egn model

description: This optical link performance calculator, by Yanchao Jiang and Pierluigi Poggiolini of Politecnico di Torino, implements the polynomial closed-form version of the GN and EGN models of non-linear fibre propagation. It computes the generalised signal-to-noise ratio of every channel of a multi-band, multi-span optical link, including amplified spontaneous emission, non-linear interference split into self- and cross-channel parts, inter-channel stimulated Raman scattering, forward and backward Raman amplification and double Rayleigh back-scattering; examples include 1,000 km C+L+S, 3,000 km C+L and 7,000 km C-band systems. Coverage: any link configuration the user defines. Format and access: MATLAB code with compiled MEX files for Windows and Linux on Zenodo, version 2.2 of May 2026, free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: needs MATLAB; compiled parts are not open source; accuracy limits are documented for very low dispersion. Simulation uses: physical-layer quality of transmission estimates for capacity planning of long-haul and submarine links and for margins in optical network design. Related records: GNPy offers an open planning tool, and the PASSION planner and reference topologies use such estimates.
